description: This file defines CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) related functions, types, and includes necessary headers for CRC calculations. It declares functions for calculating CRC and CRC32 checksums, intended for use in other source files.

methods.name: calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a message array of bytes.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: crc32inc
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum incrementally by updating an existing checksum with additional data.
